title: CMUI stress test catalogue
note: Each scenario perturbs a copy of the compute universe and re-runs harness/compute_scoring.py. Fixed baseline median cut-lines; report MoS compression and quadrant movers.

scenarios.name: Open-weight release shock (DeepSeek V4 analogue)
scenarios.industry_standard: Demand externalization — joint tightness and spot spike
scenarios.description: 48h window: tightness proxy doubles; shock calendar exposure maxes on L3 buyers/clouds.

pass_criteria.note: Release shock must surface ≥2 L3 Exposed.

scenarios.name: Capacity shortfall — tightness +150%
scenarios.industry_standard: Availability peril — hours delivered below contract
scenarios.description: Tightness sensitivity maxed on all market-linked L3 entities.

pass_criteria.note: At least one L3 must land Exposed; max universe MoS drop ≥8.

scenarios.name: H100 spot crash replay ($8→$2)
scenarios.description: Vol exposure and basis gap widen on unhedged L3 procurement.

pass_criteria.note: Spot crash analogue must move at least one entity's MoS.

scenarios.name: Forward curve inversion — obsolescence repricing
scenarios.industry_standard: Economic depreciation — F12m/F0 below obsolescence threshold
scenarios.description: Forward-implied residual collapse on institutional holders.

pass_criteria.note: Neocloud with fleet exposure must show MoS compression.

scenarios.name: Top customer revenue exit (HHI shock)
scenarios.industry_standard: Customer concentration — revenue cliff on largest buyer

pass_criteria.note: HHI > 0.28 sets whale_risk concentration flag on neocloud.

scenarios.name: Parametric basis mismatch — wrong index trigger
scenarios.industry_standard: Basis risk — index class misaligned with economic loss
scenarios.description: Severe basis gap on all L2/L3 with parametric product exposure.

pass_criteria.note: Parametrix retains underwriting posture (whitespace or earning_it) under basis stress.

scenarios.name: UK curtailment + compute tightness joint trigger
scenarios.industry_standard: Joint peril — grid non-firm AND silicon tightness
scenarios.description: NFRI grid coupling ×1.5 on linked asset; tightness spike on same entity.

pass_criteria.note: Kao Harlow must land Exposed under joint grid–compute stress.

scenarios.name: Hedge ineffectiveness — h → 0.1 on L3
scenarios.industry_standard: Basis / hedge failure — unhedged notional spike
scenarios.description: All L3 hedge coverage collapses; capacity at risk rises.

pass_criteria.note: Hedge failure must keep L3 buyers/clouds in Exposed quadrant.

scenarios.name: Reinsurer capacity pull on L2/L1
scenarios.description: MGAs and carriers lose reinsurance preparedness mid-year.

pass_criteria.note: Parametrix product_fit must compensate vs Beazley under capital pull.
